component.name: Arc Software
component.summary: Discover and install apps from Flathub and local package files
Apps aus Flathub entdecken und lokale Pakete installieren

description.p: Arc is a software center for Linux that lets you browse and install Flatpak applications from Flathub and install local package files (.deb, .rpm, .pkg.tar.zst) into isolated Distrobox containers with automatic desktop integration.

Arc ist ein Software-Center für Linux, das das Durchsuchen und Installieren von Flatpak-Apps aus Flathub sowie die Installation lokaler Pakete (.deb, .rpm, .pkg.tar.zst) in isolierten Distrobox-Containern mit automatischer Desktop-Integration ermöglicht.

ul.li: Browse popular and recently added apps from Flathub
Install Flatpak apps with one click
Open .deb, .rpm, or Arch packages and install them via Distrobox
Offers a Flathub alternative when opening a package file
